precursors.name: tris(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato) indium(III)
precursors.evidence: Crystalline In2O3 thin films were deposited by atomic layer deposition (ALD) using tris(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato) indium(III), [In(TMHD)3] as an indium source and O2 plasma.

purge_gas.name: Ar
